files.README.md:
# Ruddleway Farm - picking sheet

The farm has two plots called Hill Field, one at the north end and one at the south
end, and the sheet names the plot each tray came from. One row for each picking day.

turns.prompt: Ruddleway Farm is sending the September tray count to the packhouse. How many trays came off Hill Field in September?
The north plot. Give the number alone, as digits, with no label. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
